reason: the ledger reads the actor of a commit from its Signed-off-by value with a pattern that scans from every start position, so a run of "<" just under 1 MiB in one commit message keeps build running past the 120-second bound of the step (100,000 characters alone take about 55 s). Meanwhile the ledger tests cover ordinary trailers.
scenario: A hostile commit trailer does not stall build
